mechanism: The vertical ranking of {{category}}s or objects: every pair related by the ranking stands in an Upper/Lower relation. What the ranking *carries* varies by kind — a class hierarchy carries inheritance, an organisational one carries authority, a containment one carries neither — so those are implementer concerns rather than part of the ranking itself.
gloss: Vertical rank ordering with Upper/Lower relations, inheritance, and authority
invariants: Acyclicity: no node is above itself, directly or transitively — a cycle leaves the ranking undefined.
Antisymmetry: if A is Upper to B then B is not Upper to A.
